title: Interactive Management Action Prioritization Application
text: application decision support tool help prioritize management actions Nature Conservancy Canada. Data can uploaded using Excel Spreadsheet (optional) shapefile delineating spatial location sites. Prioritizations generated using mixed integer programming techniques. performance candidate prioritizations can examined using summary statistics tables. Finally, data prioritizations can also downloaded subsequent analysis.

title: Interactive Management Action Prioritization Application
text: application Shiny web application developed using R statistical computing environment. Specifically, uses golem framework. means application effectively R package contains code defining launching application (see details). R code files (located ./R directory) organized using following naming conventions: app_config.R: Imports configuration settings. app_global.R: Initializes application. performs similar global.R file typical Shiny applications. app_server.R: Defines (back-end) server-side logic application. performs similar role server.R file typical Shiny applications. app_ui.R: Defines (font-end) user interface application. performs similar role ui.R file typical Shiny applications. server_*: Defines components used assemble server-side logic application. ui_*: Defines functions used programmatically create HTML elements front-end application. fct_*: Defines R functions used back-end application. files contain code used perform analyses manipulate classes. utils_*: Defines utility R functions used back-end application.

title: whattodo: Interactive management action prioritization application — whattodo
text: application decision support tool help prioritize management actions Nature Conservancy Canada. Data can uploaded using Excel Spreadsheet (optional) shapefile delineating spatial location sites. Prioritizations generated using mixed integer programming techniques. performance candidate prioritizations can examined using summary statistics tables. Finally, data prioritizations can also downloaded subsequent analysis.
